answer: The spiral assignment is published and cedar records each panel. Shards are assigned from the voyage graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3247 identities would post 1207 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
